from collections import Counter, deque

def components(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col=grid[r][c]
            if (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==col:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((col,cells))
    return out

def detect_marker(grid):
    cs=components(grid)
    candidates=[]
    for col,cells in cs:
        if len(cells)<8: continue
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; xs=[c for r,c in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(xs),max(xs)
        H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        if min(H,W)<4: continue
        S=set(cells)
        # Look for a bounding-box corner whose two outward edges are fully present.
        for corner,hr,vr in [((r0,c0),range(c0,c1+1),range(r0,r1+1)),
                              ((r0,c1),range(c0,c1+1),range(r0,r1+1)),
                              ((r1,c0),range(c0,c1+1),range(r0,r1+1)),
                              ((r1,c1),range(c0,c1+1),range(r0,r1+1))]:
            cr,cc=corner
            if all((cr,x) in S for x in hr) and all((y,cc) in S for y in vr):
                candidates.append((len(cells),col,cells,(r0,r1,c0,c1),corner))
    if not candidates: return None
    return max(candidates,key=lambda z:z[0])

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

from collections import Counter

def _components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen, out = set(), []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r, c) in seen: continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack, cells = [(r, c)], []
            seen.add((r, c))
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop(); cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((color, cells))
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    components = _components(g)
    markers = []
    for color, cells in components:
        if color == background or len(cells) < 8: continue
        rows = [r for r,c in cells]; cols = [c for r,c in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1 = min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
        height,width = r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        if min(height,width) < 4 or len(cells) != height+width-1: continue
        s = set(cells)
        corners = ((r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1))
        for cr,cc in corners:
            if all((cr,x) in s for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and all((y,cc) in s for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
                markers.append((len(cells),color,cells,(r0,r1,c0,c1),(cr,cc)))
    if not markers: return g
    _, marker_color, marker_cells, (r0,r1,c0,c1), (cr,cc) = max(markers,key=lambda x:x[0])
    marker_set = set(marker_cells)
    down, up = cr == r0, cr == r1
    right, left = cc == c0, cc == c1
    options = []
    for color, cells in components:
        if color in (background, marker_color) or len(cells) < 2 or any(p in marker_set for p in cells): continue
        rows = [r for r,c in cells]; cols = [c for r,c in cells]
        if down and right:  # top-left L corner: target is above and to its left

        elif up and left:  # bottom-right L corner: target lies just beyond its vertical arm

            distance = min(cols)-c1-1
        else:
            distance = min(abs(r-cr)+abs(c-cc) for r,c in cells)
        options.append((distance,-len(cells),color,cells))
    if not options: return g
    nearest = min(o[0] for o in options)
    pool = [o for o in options if o[0] <= nearest + 4]
    _,_,_,target_cells = min(pool,key=lambda o:(o[1],o[0]))
    for r,c in target_cells: g[r][c] = marker_color
